[Intro]
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]Am[/ch]


[Verse 1]
[tab]         [ch]G[/ch]                                        [ch]Am[/ch]
Did you know I'd go to sleep and leave the lights on[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Bm[/ch]                                [ch]Am[/ch]
Hoping you'd come by and know that I was home and still awake[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                       [ch]Am[/ch]
But two years go by and still my light's on[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]Bm[/ch]                             [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]D[/ch]
This is hard for me to say but this is all that I can take[/tab]


[Chorus]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                   [ch]Am[/ch]
It's the last song I'll ever write for you[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Bm[/ch]
It's the last time that I'll tell you[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Am[/ch]
Just how much I really care[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]G[/ch]                   [ch]Am[/ch]
This is the last song I'll ever sing for you[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]Bm[/ch]
You'll come looking for the light[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]D[/ch]
And it won't be there[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]Am7[/ch]
But I love you[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]
Oh yes I do[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]Am[/ch]
Yes I do[/tab]


[Verse 2]
[tab]          [ch]G[/ch]                                    [ch]Am[/ch]
All the times that I spent waiting wondering where you are[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]Bm[/ch]                                    [ch]Am[/ch]
Always knew the time would come when I would start to wonder why[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]G[/ch]                         [ch]Am[/ch]
Now the time is here I don't know where you are[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Bm[/ch]                                  [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]
So I'll write you one more song but it's the last time that I'll try[/tab]
